title: It is good to give thanks

request.style: English, Warm female solo voice with gentle choir harmonies, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, reverent and joyful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A psalm for the Sabbath day
It is good to give thanks to the LORD
to sing praise to your name, O Most High

[Chorus]
It is good to give thanks to the LORD
to sing praise to your name, O Most High
to declare your steadfast love in the morning
and your faithfulness through the nights

[Verse]
On the ten-stringed lute and on the harp
to the melody of the lyre
For you have made me glad by your work
O LORD, I sing for joy at your hands

[Chorus]
It is good to give thanks to the LORD
to sing praise to your name, O Most High
to declare your steadfast love in the morning
and your faithfulness through the nights

[Bridge]
Your deeds of hands bring me joy
Your work makes my heart glad
O LORD, I praise you always
In morning light and through the night

[Chorus]
It is good to give thanks to the LORD
to sing praise to your name, O Most High
to declare your steadfast love in the morning
and your faithfulness through the nights

[Outro]
It is good to give thanks to the LORD
to sing praise to your name, O Most High
